conventions.angle: radians in (-pi, pi]; the zero vector has no direction (null)
conventions.negativeZero: -0 components are canonicalised to +0 before evaluation
conventions.exact: ||v|| = coefficient * sqrt(radicand), radicand square-free; integer components only

tolerance.unit: ulps of the expected value (math.ulp); the smallest subnormal spacing is used at 0
tolerance.rationale: Math.hypot, Math.atan2 and libm need not be correctly rounded and may differ in the last bits; x*x + y*y rounds up to three times. Observed maxima against this oracle on Node 24 / V8: magnitude 2, magnitudeSquared 1, directionRadians 1, directionDegrees 3 ulps; the tolerances leave headroom for other engines yet stay ~1e-15 relative. These are test tolerances, not mathematical equalities (plan §10.4). Exact forms and zero/undefined policies must match EXACTLY.
